item.title: web zine workshop
item.description:
NSS Rainy Day Web Zine - Issue 0
In 1991, a coffee maker at the Univerity of Cambridge went online. The Trojan Room Coffee Pot cam was the very first webcam.
To save people working in the building the disappointment of finding the coffee machine empty after making the trip to the room, a camera was set up providing a live picture of the coffee pot to all desktop computers on the office network. After the camera was connected to the Internet a few years later, the coffee pot gained international renown
